# Profound Medical to Participate in Lake Street’s 10th Annual Best Ideas Growth Conference


September 03, 2026 8:15am EDT


TORONTO, Sept. 03, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) --[Profound Medical Corp.](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=jdVH2kvCBh7d1HIXnrjsUBOUSHxWV1b6YT-gDQDUaDDLuZhRYcxrAya5MDKXBTn6PwQ2__M_x6o4AKbzFt1lS8Z8Uq3RxUbnO467UzdLt10=) (NASDAQ:PROF; TSX:PRN) (“Profound” or the “Company”), a commercial-stage medical device company that develops and markets innovative interventional MRI (iMRI) procedures, announced today that management will participate in the Lake Street Capital Markets “BIG10” Conference on September 10, 2026 in New York City.


The event will consist of one-on-one investor meetings. Due to the format of the event, no webcast will be available.


**About Profound Medical Corp.**


Profound is a commercial-stage medical device company and an innovator in interventional MRI (iMRI) procedures. The company’s flagship platform,[TULSA-PRO](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=TJWAt0dKhuLYzVnO3N4Ufu-OYT16b4UvDl197GgAcE_rDYVc2_l51TQmJmQ4kTAXzM3C2Uyb87eVuDsLd3wLg33liRT8-q0B7B0gBAvbp_s=)[®](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=Jh4dZzIoKOIQj1P8LFHp0lLr6NUn9ClbbS1Y-R6erCCnqdepC4Bq6eN7jXJ2rZrudVgulEztwyDqL1-K9-Onk7e7Z8UdQtFGJatJIrx2nbA=) , enables MRI-guided, incision-free prostate ablation. Physicians use the[TULSA Procedure™](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=TJWAt0dKhuLYzVnO3N4UfnWgCSXaCodxd89cse_0PMmc67JasKbWbTnu-LD4xI5X8rMP6iKYXDMXf6ktGtrSHo6w3yQl_dhhTHLR3rQo8jXK5C-TDmaghCYE9MU1GRCdhId4n2Y5jG-1cLJxFFOiNA==) to see, ablate, and confirm therapy in real time, supporting personalized treatment strategies across the continuum of prostate care—from whole-gland to subtotal, hemi, multifocal, and focal treatment. This approach enables individualized care using prostate tissue ablation, while minimizing the potential of the side effects that are typically associated with surgery or radiation, such as urinary incontinence and/or erectile dysfunction.


Profound also commercializes[Sonalleve](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=_cIsewBPXPlyjOdhwXEvbysuIaWaMhFC5LCaYOPiC54hvYRqV_V30KUGpeaSFt2nztB0WsKmwQZA0TD4tR9exRad8Jv0Bk7TPpoxEcjb_t4=)[®](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=aOTeRKMcq-fA5M0pjyqXaCiOIGUKEIrSHVjgMIU2tZemV8GOj7MiDekXwfKRYg26BI7Pm3iE_TbdmLzRo5SA-Bf58QH_zurOpWqy7oC4Ja0=) , an MRI-guided therapy that provides a non-surgical treatment option for pain palliation of bone metastases, desmoid tumors, and osteoid osteoma, as well as for common gynecologic conditions including uterine fibroids and adenomyosis. Sonalleve delivers targeted therapy with no incisions, no blood loss during the procedure, no overnight hospital stay, and faster recovery — and, in gynecologic applications, enables uterine-sparing treatment that may help preserve fertility. Profound is also exploring additional clinical applications for Sonalleve, including non-invasive ablation of abdominal cancers and hyperthermia-based cancer therapies.


Profound Medical’s technologies are approved across major global markets. TULSA-PRO is cleared by the FDA in the United States for transurethral ultrasound ablation (TULSA) of prostate tissue. In addition, TULSA-PRO is cleared for use in various jurisdictions including Europe, Canada, Saudi Arabia, India, Australia/New Zealand, and the UAE. Sonalleve is approved by the FDA as HDE in the United States for the treatment of osteoid osteomas in the extremities. Sonalleve is also cleared or approved in the Europe, Canada, China, and Saudi Arabia.


Through real-time MRI guidance and data-driven innovation, Profound is advancing the future of MRI-guided therapy — expanding access to precise, personalized, and incision-free treatment options worldwide.
